methodologyNotes: Self-serve USD pricing was collected on 2026-06-15 from each vendor's official pricing or product pages via WebFetch. Where an official page returned HTTP 403 (Namecheap — all paths) or used JavaScript-only price rendering (GlobalSign shop.globalsign.com renders prices dynamically after region/currency selection — bullet-placeholder '•' visible in raw HTML), monthlyUsd is set to null and provenance explains the failure mode. GoGetSSL catalog pages (gogetssl.com/ssl-certificates/*) returned usable HTML price tables and serve as the primary source for GoGetSSL's own-brand plans. Sectigo's official site (sectigo.com) only publishes a headline '$110/yr DV SSL' figure; per-product breakdowns come from GoGetSSL's reseller catalog pages which carry Sectigo-branded products at reseller rates — noted in provenance. DigiCert pricing was taken from digicert.com/tls-ssl/ (subscription monthly rates, 12-month auto-renewing); the compare-certificates page shows different per-cert retail prices and is recorded as corroboration with a note. ZeroSSL is included as a modern alternative with clearly published self-serve pricing. All plans have minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, and overagePerCall set to null (non-telephony vertical). billingModel is 'flat' for all fixed-term certificate plans; 'custom' for quote-only enterprise tiers. hipaa/baa/bilingual are null unless explicitly stated on the vendor page. monthlyUsd is the effective monthly cost of the cheapest annual term (annual price / 12). annualDiscountPct is recorded only where the vendor explicitly publishes both a monthly and an annual rate, or two different term lengths with percentages. SSL certificate validity changed industry-wide to a maximum of ~200 days (two 90-day or one 199-day issuance) as of March 2026 (CA/Browser Forum BR); all plans reflect this context in notes.
